description_en: Adds one or more existing ECS instances as compute nodes to a specified cluster
description_zh: 添加一个或多个已创建的ECS实例作为计算节点，加入到指定集群中
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc add-existed-nodes --cluster-id 'ehpc-hz-FYUr32****' --image-id centos_7_06_64_20G_alibase_20190711.vhd --image-owner-alias system --instance '[{"Id":"i-bp16mxn6mt3t7ftk****"}]' --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddExistedNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster to which the node is to be added.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
该节点待加入的集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The image specified for the compute node to be added to the cluster. The image must meet the following conditions:

The operating system of the specified image must be the same as the operating system of the nodes in the cluster. For example, if the operating system of the nodes in the cluster is CentOS, you can only specify a CentOS image.
If the cluster is a hybrid cloud cluster and the multi-operating system feature is enabled, when the operating system of the nodes in the cluster is Windows, the specified image can be Windows or CentOS.

The major version number of the specified image must be the same as that of the image used by the nodes in the cluster. For example, if the cluster uses CentOS 7.x, the specified image must also be CentOS 7.x.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html operations to query the image ID
parameters.help_zh:
为待加入集群的计算节点指定的镜像，该镜像需满足以下条件：

指定的镜像的操作系统应与集群中节点的操作系统保持一致。如：集群中节点的操作系统为CentOS时，只能指定CentOS镜像。
如果集群为混合云集群，并且开启支持多系统功能，当集群中节点的操作系统为Windows时，指定的镜像可以为Windows、CentOS。

指定的镜像应与集群节点的镜像大版本号保持一致，如待加入集群为CentOS 7.x，指定的镜像也应该为CentOS 7.x。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html接口获取镜像ID
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The queue in the cluster to which the node is to be added
parameters.help_zh: 该节点要加入的集群中的队列
parameters.name: job_queue

parameters.help_en:
The image type. Valid values:

system: public image

self: custom image

others: shared image

marketplace: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image

Default value: system
parameters.help_zh:
镜像类型。取值范围：

system：公共镜像

self：自定义镜像

others：共享镜像

marketplace：镜像市场镜像

默认值：system
parameters.name: image_owner_alias

fields.help_en: The ID of the Nth node to be added. N starts from 1. Valid values: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 第N个（N从1开始编号，可以有多条）要添加的节点ID。取值范围：1~100
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: The information about the node to be added
parameters.name: instance
